Automatic doors that never open unintentionally while driving

Proposal
1, implement. Automatic doors draw 40 complaint rows (9 defects, 30 usability) next to 45 likes. Several owners report that a knee touches the inside button and the door opens while driving: a safety risk on a flagship feature.
Horizon
H1. Interlock logic is software; button guard or relocation fits the life-cycle impulse.
Domain
Interior Comfort & Materials
Markets
US
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-G70-US-IC-01 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

The electric doors shall not open from an inside button while the car is moving or a gear is engaged, shall start moving within an agreed delay, and shall close reliably from outside with a clearly placed button.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USDoor opening from inside button above walking speed or in gearNot possibleFunction and safety testevidence
USDelay from button press to door movement<= 0.5 sFunction testassumption
USAutomatic door defect rows0 in the next feedback waveCustomer feedbackassumption
